pages.text: $(br2)$(bold)Raw Radiant Quartz$() $(l:items/raw_quartz)Raw Radiant Quartz$() generates Liquid Starlight. It is long lasting, but low production.$(br2)$(bold)Shaped Radiant Quartz$() $(l:items/shaped_quartz)Shaped Radiant Quartz$() also generates Liquid Starlight. It is a bit more efficient than Raw Radiant Quartz.
pages.title: Lightwell

pages.text: $(l:gems/rivertear)Rivertears$() generate water at about 2 buckets per tick. It is effectively infinite, but due to technical limits there is a ridiculously small chance of shattering.$(br2)$(l:gems/mountaintear)Mountaintears$() generate lava at a moderate rate. It is effectively infinite, but due to technical limits there is a ridiculously small chance of shattering.
